Priya R.: quick ask — our moderator for Thurs 11am PT (panel for infra L4) just pinged OOO. Can someone cover or split the session? Also small rubric question: should we normalize system-design vs leadership scores before averaging? Link to debrief doc: https://go/redwood/panel-debrief
Samir Patel: I can take the first 30m (intro + systems). Can hand off to someone for culture/leadership slice. :+1:
Elena K.: I can do the second half (leadership + debrief). timezone note: I’ll be remote from EMEA but ok for 11am PT. Do we need Zoom co-host rights or a moderator script?
Priya R.: thanks both. Zoom co-host would be ideal. Jordan, can you add co-host to Samir and Elena for that meeting? people-ops-bot: scheduled meeting created: https://calendar.redwood/ev/3956789012
Jordan (People Ops): added co-hosts and updated calendar. Also clarifying rubric: we ask interviewers to score raw on the three axes, then we normalize to a 0-10 scale before averaging. Canonical weights are: technical 60%, leadership 25%, culture 15%.
Samir Patel: handy — can you drop the formula here? I’ll paste into the panel chat.
Jordan (People Ops): sure. Use the conversion: 
```
normalized = round((raw_score / max_raw) * 10, 1)
composite = round(technical_norm * 0.6 + leadership_norm * 0.25 + culture_norm * 0.15, 1)
```
Then leave a quick comment on the score rationale in the debrief doc.
Elena K.: what’s max_raw for each axis? We usually use different scales in handoffs (like 1-5 for culture).
Jordan (People Ops): canonical maxs: technical=40, leadership=10, culture=5 (these sum to 55 raw points). If your interview uses 1-5 for culture, multiply accordingly or use the per-axis max above when normalizing.
Priya R.: ok that helps. Quick QA: if an interviewer forgets to normalize, do we normalize centrally in the debrief sheet or ask them to update?
Jordan (People Ops): we auto-normalize in the debrief sheet script but prefer interviewers to paste raw scores and a 1-line rationale. Automation will show both raw and normalized so SRE/ICs can see edits.
Samir Patel: great. I’ll add myself as co-host and paste the moderator checklist: intro (5m), system Q1 (15m), system Q2 (10m), leadership (20m), debrief (10m).
Elena K.: add a note to remind panel to mute mics when others ask questions. Small thing but helps.
Priya R.: thanks all. tagging final steps: @Jordan please confirm co-host in calendar (done) and @people-ops-bot drop the checklist into meeting notes. Will follow up if anything else changes. :sparkles:
